engine: White Caves Apex Champions Leaderboard Engine

TRACK_SALES_ELITE.name: Sales Elite Track
TRACK_SALES_ELITE.description: Ranked primarily by Gross Written Commission (GWC) points accumulated across residential sales transactions.

TRACK_LEASING_VOLUME.name: Leasing Volume Engine
TRACK_LEASING_VOLUME.description: Ranked primarily by total quantity of tenancy deal units transacted + rental commission density.

monthlyCaveMaster.triggerCondition: Rank 1 in Sales Elite OR Leasing Volume Track at monthly reset cron execution

quarterlyPortfolioDirector.triggerCondition: Rank 1-3 average position across full quarter (3 consecutive months)

annualChairmansCircle.triggerCondition: Overall Annual Champion across combined Sales & Leasing Leaderboard at annual reset cron execution
annualChairmansCircle.ruleDescription: Locks the agent's commission split at an uncapped 75% floor for the entire following calendar year, ignoring rolling monthly revenue dips.
